description:
Her full name is Chisato Nishikigi.
She is actually said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She happily resolves the troubles of ordinary citizens that are ignored by DA.
She calls herself the official mascot of Café LycoReco and goes about her work cheerfully and energetically.

levels.name: Extrasensory
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Charges Extrasensory to 100%, up to 100%. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.</color>
■ Activates while in Extrasensory status. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the charge level of Extrasensory. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:
Only when at 100%: Dodging Bullets: Invulnerable for 2 sec.
Only when above 70%: ATK ▲ 31.72%. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Only when above 55%: True Damage ▲ 28.73%. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Only when above 25%: Hit Rate ▲ 13.22%. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.</color>
■ Affects self every 2 sec.
<color=#00AEFF>Extrasensory ▼ 1%.</color>

lines.text: I should probably go help open up the cafe, huh?
Ta-da! One Chisato Special, just for you!
Hey, welcome! You should join us for board game night!
Someday, I hope you can come over to our world!
Come stop by the cafe! We've got a special event going on!
Hey! Wanna do some warm-up exercises?
Ooh, wanna go there? Or over there?! I wanna see everything!
I'm like a whole new Chisato now!
I leveled up again! Just how strong am I going to get?!
You're giving this to me? Really? Thanks!
I'm gonna brag about this to Takina and Kurumi!
You wanna give your favorite Chisato a special present, right? Mm-hmm... I get it, I get it!
I've met a lot of good people in this town.
I'm never going to forget our time together!
I've made so many friends here. I love it!
I got this, I got this...
This is gonna hurt a bit!
Sorry, I'm gonna take a quick break!
Another job down! We did great!
